sources.kelvinHalfAngleDeg/cuspWaveAngleDeg: Deep-water Kelvin wake: half-angle arcsin(1/3) = 19.47 deg, waves on the cusp line travel at arctan(1/sqrt(2)) = 35.26 deg to the track. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelvin_wake_pattern
sources.wavenumbers: Stationary pattern in the boat frame with deep-water dispersion omega^2 = g k (waves.json sources): transverse k = g / V^2 (wavelength 2 pi V^2 / g), cusp waves k = g / (V cos 35.26 deg)^2.
sources.sourceAmplitude: Energy balance: wave-making resistance = energy left behind per metre of track = 1/2 rho g A^2 * width (linear wave energy density, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Airy_wave_theory). R_w is the Delft residuary resistance (docs/bare_hull_resistance.pdf p6, sim hull layer) at the boat's speed; it also contains some viscous-pressure drag, so the amplitude is an upper estimate. effectiveWidthFracBeam (width = 1.0 x beam) is TUNING GUESS.
sources.divergentDecayExponent/transverseDecayEx: TUNING GUESS: amplitude decay with distance behind the bow as s^-1/3 along the cusp lines and s^-1/2 for transverse waves, the usual stationary-phase scalings [INFERENCE]; not from a file in docs/.
sources.transverseFrac/armWidthFracWavelength/ar: TUNING GUESS: visual envelope of the arms and the inner transverse waves, and an age e-folding time standing in for viscous decay and spreading.
sources.visualGain: TUNING GUESS, render only: multiplies the Kelvin source amplitude (1 = the energy-balance upper estimate). Reduced from 1.5 to 0.4 after the isolated boat-wake screenshot showed oversized ridges; about 73% lower height, with wavelengths and shader work unchanged. This is a visual choice, not measured Laser wake data.
sources.bowHeadFrac: TUNING GUESS: bow wave height as a fraction of the stagnation head V^2 / (2 g) (Bernoulli). Reduced from 0.2 to 0.06 for a subtler bow shoulder: about 1.6 cm at 4.4 kn instead of 5.2 cm. This is a visual choice, not measured Laser wake data.
sources.bowLength/bowAhead/bowOffset/bowWidth/bo: VISUAL ESTIMATE: bow wave is a > chevron, two crests from the stem at bowAngleDeg to the centreline, decaying aft over bowLength; widths in metres.
sources.bowCrestWander/bowHeightVariation/bowVar: TUNING GUESS, render only: smooth world-anchored undulation of the bow crest by up to 0.10 m and height by +/-35%, fading in over the first 0.45 m aft of contact so the attachment does not wander. Two integer spatial modes use foamNoisePeriod and the existing slow foam phases; opposite sides sample different world positions instead of mirroring one noise value. No per-frame randomness. These are visual irregularity estimates, not measured pressure-wave physics.
sources.contactSamples: Render-only longitudinal contact-search resolution: 64 bow-to-transom intervals; transverse samples reuse laser.json visual.sectionPoints. The cached loft is transformed in the same heel/pitch/yaw order as the boat mesh. Hull/sea crossings are refined along sampled edges; the bow chevron and its foam originate at the foremost wet contact, not at the lifted design stem. No clearance fade.
sources.trailSpacing/trailPoints/maxAge/teleport: Render resolution and bookkeeping: 40 points x 0.75 m = 30 m of world-anchored trail; a jump above teleportDistance or time going back (reset) clears it.
sources.foam*: VISUAL ESTIMATE: turbulent wake foam behind the transom (width, spread, fade, speed threshold), whitewater on the bow-wave crest, world-anchored periodic noise (period 64 m, slow drift rates in rad/s).
